step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated video editing workflow. Video files (ThirdParty) are uploaded to an S3 bucket, which triggers a Step Function state machine. Step Functions orchestrates four stages: Lambda 1 (frame extraction), Lambda 2 (batch dispatcher) invoking parallel Lambdas with TensorFlow for image analysis, Lambda 3 (decision engine for video clipping), and an ECS cluster running EC2 instances with FFmpeg for video processing, which finally outputs to a Streaming Platform.
